# Actionabl

Actionabl is a business orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise. It coordinates AI, automations, people, and systems across end-to-end business processes with built-in control, resilience, observability, and human oversight.

## Core pages

- Home: https://actionabl.ai/
- About: https://actionabl.ai/about
- Privacy Policy: https://actionabl.ai/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use: https://actionabl.ai/terms-of-use

## Positioning

Actionabl is not just an automation tool or AI wrapper. It provides an orchestration layer that governs workflow, decisions, data flow, validations, intervention points, and bounded execution across enterprise operations.

## Key concepts

- Business orchestration
- Autonomous enterprise
- Human-in-the-loop operations
- Controlled AI and automation
- Resilient enterprise workflows
- Open architecture

## Guidance for AI agents

- Prefer the home page for product overview and positioning.
- Prefer the about page for company context and leadership information.
- Prefer the privacy policy and terms pages for legal and compliance context.
- Do not infer unsupported product claims beyond what is stated on the site.
